title: com.docker.sandbox/mcp-registration@1
description: Registers one remote MCP server with the sandbox: the runtime connects to it outside the sandbox and offers its tools to the agent, with no registration on the host by the person. Instance-shaped on name. The @1 names the capability contract, including this config schema and observable behavior. RELEASES.md defines when versions move.

name.description: Identifies the server among those the agent is offered.

url.description: The server's streamable HTTP endpoint. Its host must appear in the network policy's runtime allow list (or be covered by a bare wildcard).

access.description: Name of the cross-app-access entry, declared beside this one, whose access token the runtime presents to the server. Absent reaches the server without a credential.
